name: Soul Of The Paintings
source:
You are a young man living alone in the city with no particular meaning in life, one day it all changes when you run into some weird old lady.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/TiDeMooN]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名独居在城市里的年轻男子，生活并没有什么特别的意义。直到某一天，你遇见了一位古怪的老太太，一切就此改变。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/TiDeMooN]Patreon[/url]]
